notes:
### Fixed
- **Stale UI after an APK update.** The PWA service worker shipped inside the
  APK and its precache persisted across updates, so a freshly installed APK
  could keep serving the previous build until the app was killed and
  relaunched. The worker is now web-only: the native app no longer registers it
  and cleans up any legacy registration/caches on launch, while the web build
  reloads once when a new worker takes control.

### Notes
- No scan-index rebuild required: the descriptor, `SCAN_VERSION`, `DATA_VERSION`
  and card data are untouched.
